groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Strong Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.718% and the 10Y at 5.025%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -0.51% over five sessions and -1.98% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +3.34% at about $112.45, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is strong negative (-52/100, 89% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
